English(en): A rusted pump stands here. The oil stain on the ground has dried.
Korean(ko): 녹슨 주유기가 서 있다. 바닥에 기름 얼룩이 말랐다.

English(en): Scraped together what oil was left.
Cut a hand on the rusted tank.
The box still held oil and parts.
Korean(ko): 박스 안에 기름과 부품이 남아 있었다.

English(en): Only one can of oil was left.
The oil smell gave someone a headache.
A tree lies across the road.
Nearly crushed by the trunk. Someone got hurt.
Chopped it down and kept the usable pieces.
Korean(ko): 나무를 베어 쓸 만한 조각을 챙겼다.

English(en): A car with a door half open. A trace of air freshener lingers.
Korean(ko): 문이 반쯤 열린 차. 방향제 냄새가 남아 있다.

English(en): Found something useful between the seats.
Korean(ko): 시트 사이에서 쓸 만한 걸 찾았다.

English(en): Someone was cut by broken glass.
There was scrap in the trunk.
The air freshener smell clung. Someone got a headache.
Korean(ko): 방향제 냄새가 따라붙어 누군가 머리가 아팠다.

English(en): The doors are locked. A bag is visible through the window.
Korean(ko): 문이 잠긴 차. 창 너머로 가방이 보인다.

English(en): The bag held food and water.
Someone was badly cut by the shards.
The door gave. The bag was packed.

Korean(ko): 가방이 눈앞에 아른거려 누군가 잠을 설쳤다.

English(en): An open well. Water echoes from the bottom.
Korean(ko): 뚜껑이 열린 우물. 바닥에서 물소리가 난다.

English(en): The bucket came up with water.
Only an empty bucket came up.
Found water and scrap at the bottom.
The sound of water wouldn't leave someone's ears.
Standing water. The color is wrong.
No ill effects. Filled up on water.
Someone got badly sick after drinking.
The tablet dissolved and the water cleared.
The "OPEN" sign is still lit. The door is open.
Korean(ko): "영업 중" 간판이 아직 켜져 있다. 문은 열려 있다.

English(en): Found something useful in a corner.
Everything was expired. Someone got sick eating it.
Korean(ko): 유통기한이 지난 것뿐이었다. 먹고 누군가 앓았다.

English(en): The stockroom shelves were nearly untouched.
The stockroom had been cleaned out.
The lit sign kept nagging at someone.
A few coins lie at the bottom. There's a slot for wishes.
Korean(ko): 동전 몇 개가 가라앉은 우물. 소원을 비는 칸이 있다.

English(en): The wish came true. The well spat out gold.
Almost fell in. Someone got hurt.
Skipping the wish left a nagging feeling.
A vending machine still glows. Nobody knows where the power comes from.
Korean(ko): 자판기가 아직 켜져 있다. 전기가 어디서 오는지는 아무도 모른다.

English(en): The machine hummed to itself. Nerves frayed.
Korean(ko): 자판기가 혼자 웅웅 울어 신경이 곤두섰다.

English(en): "Refuge Zone 7 →" The arrow points back the way you came.
Korean(ko): "제7 피난구역 →" 화살표가 가던 방향의 반대를 가리킨다.

English(en): A map fragment was wedged under the arrow.
Korean(ko): 화살표 밑에 지도 조각이 끼워져 있었다.

English(en): Went a long way and came back. Only burned fuel.
Found a map and something useful behind the sign.
Korean(ko): 표지판 뒤에서 지도와 쓸 만한 물건을 찾았다.

English(en): The arrow wouldn't leave someone's mind.
A car is burning. The fire looks ready to spread.
Korean(ko): 차 한 대가 타고 있다. 불길이 번질 것 같다.

English(en): Pulled scrap out of the embers.
Put it out and salvaged what was useful.
Korean(ko): 불을 끄고 쓸 만한 것을 챙겼다.

English(en): The engine makes a sound you've never heard.
The engine took a real beating.
Killed the engine and let it cool.
"Come now, buy one get one." The lot under the billboard is empty.
Korean(ko): "지금 오시면 1+1." 광고판 아래 주차장은 비어 있다.

English(en): Cut a hand on the panel.
Picked something useful off the ground.
"Buy one get one" looped in someone's head.
A steel crate sits in the middle of the road. The lock is thick.
Korean(ko): 도로 한복판에 쇠 상자가 놓여 있다. 자물쇠가 굵다.

English(en): Cut the lock. The crate was full.
A truck with the cargo bed open. Parts are scattered on the floor.
Korean(ko): 짐칸이 열린 트럭. 바닥에 부품이 흩어져 있다.

English(en): Someone was cut on a rusty edge.
A machine part turned up under the seat.
The truck creaked and swayed. Someone jumped.
Hauled away a load of scrap.
A stack of wrecks collapsed. Someone got hurt.
Ripped parts out of the engine.
All that came loose was a handful of scrap.
Korean(ko): 건질 수 있는 건 고철 한 줌뿐이었다.
폐차 더미가 삐걱거리는 소리에 누군가 놀랐다.

English(en): A military vehicle sits by the road. Files are scattered on the ground. The words "Refuge Zone 7" catch the eye.
Korean(ko): 군용 차량이 길가에 서 있다. 문서철이 바닥에 흩어져 있다. "제7 피난구역"이라는 글자가 보인다.

English(en): A map fragment turned up among the papers.
The cargo held a smoke grenade and a flare.
The words on the files wouldn't leave someone's head.
Korean(ko): 문서에 적힌 글자가 머릿속에서 떠나지 않았다.

English(en): The bridge is half collapsed. Hard to say if it can be crossed.
Korean(ko): 다리가 반쯤 무너져 있다. 건널 수 있을지 애매하다.

English(en): The bridge gave way. The body took heavy damage.
Filled the gap with wood and crossed.
Gave up on the bridge and turned back.
Cars stand in a line. Every driver's seat is empty.
Korean(ko): 차들이 줄지어 서 있다. 운전석은 모두 비어 있다.

English(en): Each car had a little something left.
Korean(ko): 차마다 조금씩 쓸 만한 게 남아 있었다.

English(en): Someone got hurt in one of the cars.
A cow stands in the middle of the road. It has no plans to move.
Korean(ko): 소 한 마리가 도로 한가운데 서 있다. 비킬 생각이 없다.

English(en): Waited a long time. Only the water dropped.
Left the cow and turned back.
The toll machine is still on. "Thank you. Drive safely."
Korean(ko): 징수소 정산기가 아직 켜져 있다. "감사합니다. 안전 운전하세요."

English(en): The "drive safely" oddly put someone at ease.
Korean(ko): 안전 운전하라는 말에 괜히 마음이 놓였다.

English(en): The barrier was sturdier than it looked.
Under construction. No workers, only the detour sign.
Korean(ko): 공사 중이다. 작업자는 없고 우회 안내만 남아 있다.

English(en): Followed the detour a long way around.
Passed through the work zone unscathed.
A wheel dropped into a hole.
A rest-stop sign. It smells like walnut cakes. Just a memory.
Korean(ko): 휴게소 표지판. 호두과자 냄새가 나는 것 같다. 기억일 뿐이다.

English(en): The rest stop still had something useful.
Korean(ko): 휴게소에 쓸 만한 게 남아 있었다.

English(en): Sat down and caught a breath.
Thinking of walnut cakes made someone hungry.
A big-box store parking lot. A cart rolls by itself.
Korean(ko): 대형 마트 주차장. 카트 하나가 혼자 굴러간다.
카트 안에 쓸 만한 것이 있었다.

English(en): Supplies were left deep inside the store.
Something leapt out. Someone got hurt.
The cart bumped the van and scratched it.
The road is mud. The wheels spin.
The wheels tore out of the mud.
Burned fuel and wrecked the body.
Dug out in front of the wheels and got free.
Broken glass is scattered across the road.
Cut a hand on the glass.
A fuel truck lies on its side. The smell of oil is thick.
Korean(ko): 연료 트럭이 옆으로 누웠다. 기름 냄새가 진하다.

English(en): Scraped up the oil from the ground.
The oil caught fire. Someone was badly hurt.
Korean(ko): 기름에 불이 붙어 누군가 크게 다쳤다.

English(en): Smothered the sparks and collected the oil.
The timetable says the next bus was five years ago.
Picked something up from under the bench.
Korean(ko): 벤치 밑에서 쓸 만한 걸 주웠다.

English(en): The bus never came. The legs got a rest.
Long drag marks run along the road. The trail leads into the dark.
Korean(ko): 도로에 무언가 끌고 간 자국이 길게 나 있다. 이어진 곳은 어둡다.

English(en): Scrap lay at the end of the trail.
Something brushed past in the dark. Someone got hurt.
Korean(ko): 어둠 속에서 무언가 스쳤다. 누군가 다쳤다.

English(en): Watching from afar, picked up what had been dropped.
A wheel is painted on the wall. The paint is still wet.
Korean(ko): 벽에 바퀴 그림이 칠해져 있다. 페인트가 마르지 않았다.

English(en): Caught in the act. Got beaten up.
Walked into a trap. Someone got hurt.
The speed camera flashed. Where would the ticket even go?
Korean(ko): 단속 카메라가 번쩍였다. 고지서는 어디로 가나.

English(en): Someone got shocked by the wiring.
Thinking of the ticket made someone's stomach sink.
A piano stands in the middle of the road. It's in tune.
Korean(ko): 피아노 한 대가 도로 한복판에 서 있다. 음은 맞는다.

English(en): Pressed the keys for the first time in a while. Spirits lifted.
Something drawn by the sound hurt someone.
Korean(ko): 소리를 듣고 다가온 무언가에 누군가 다쳤다.

English(en): Took the piano apart for wood and scrap.
A hand got caught under the lid.
It being in tune kept nagging at someone.
Fruit still hangs on the trees. No birds, no people.
Korean(ko): 열매가 아직 달려 있다. 새도 사람도 없다.

English(en): Fell from a branch. Someone got hurt.
The fruit stayed on someone's mind.
The tunnel mouth. Pitch black inside. No sign of the other end.
Korean(ko): 터널 입구. 안은 캄캄하다. 반대편은 보이지 않는다.

English(en): Scraped the wall in the dark. Someone got hurt.
Korean(ko): 어둠 속에서 벽을 긁었다. 누군가 다쳤다.

English(en): The light caught some abandoned cargo.
Gave up on the tunnel and turned back.
A shallow creek crosses the road.
Rocks in the water scraped the body.
